overview: The council approved a $250,000 grant for the construction of a city dog park and discussed a $500,000 sidewalk repair appropriation. The meeting also addressed public safety concerns regarding lead levels in municipal water, neighborhood nuisances, and the effectiveness of the C-Click Fix system.

items.title: Commendations and Recognitions
items.summary: The council recognized Boy Scout Troop 416 on its 100th anniversary and honored several retiring members of the Medford Fire Department.

items.title: Police Enforcement in Medford Square
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting increased police presence in Medford Square and involvement from the Substance Abuse Outreach Council to address drug and alcohol-related harassment.

items.title: Stanton Foundation Dog Park Grant
items.summary: Approved the acceptance of a $250,000 grant from the Stanton Foundation for the design and construction of a dog park at Riverbend Park. The council also approved a related resolution requesting that the mayor establish a formal Dog Park Committee.

items.title: Sidewalk and Stump Removal Appropriation
items.summary: The council discussed an appropriation of $500,000 from free cash for citywide sidewalk replacement and stump removal. The matter was tabled until the administration provides a detailed list prioritizing the 554 outstanding repair requests.

items.title: Nuisance Property at 56 Boynton Road
items.summary: Residents and councilors discussed the dangerous condition of a dilapidated property in probate; the council requested the city solicitor outline the legal process for declaring it a nuisance to allow for demolition.

items.title: MBTA Debris Cleanup on Fossil Road
items.summary: Approved a request for the MBTA to clean up brush and debris on their property along Fossil Road.

items.title: Lead Level Testing in Municipal Buildings
items.summary: Resolved to have the Board of Health and City Engineer test lead levels in the water of all municipal buildings, schools, and playground fountains following high test results at City Hall.

items.title: Cottage Street Resident Parking
items.summary: Referred a request to the Traffic Commission to amend parking signs on Cottage Street to allow resident permit parking in one-hour zones.

items.title: Charter Review Home Rule Petition Update
items.summary: Councilors expressed disappointment regarding an unfavorable report from the State Legislature's Committee on Election Laws concerning the city's charter review petition. Discussion centered on whether to continue the effort via citizen signatures.

items.title: Evaluation of C-Click Fix Program
items.summary: The council debated the effectiveness of the C-Click Fix system, citing lack of oversight, improper routing of tickets, and instances of user harassment on the platform. The council requested a quarterly performance report and a meeting with the vendor to address system flaws.

items.title: Municipal Water Consumption
items.summary: Requested a report on water consumption in city buildings and asked whether municipal facilities are currently metered to gauge conservation efforts.

items.title: Condolences and Minutes
items.summary: The council offered condolences to the family of Robert Scalise and approved the minutes from the previous meeting.
